summary: Re-review of the whole pull request after review fixes. (1) Deletion lifecycle (B5, TM-12): the pull request let the deletion worker delete a document after an upstream 'cancelled'. HindsightBackend.operation passes Hindsight's status string through unchanged, and Hindsight documents cancellation of running work as cooperative and not immediate (docs 1.3, Operations, 'Cancel an operation'): the row is marked cancelled at once while the worker may still finish and write, and its terminal status writes are guarded WHERE status <> 'cancelled'. A deletion after 'cancelled' could therefore be refilled by the same attempt while the router reports it deleted. Fixed before publication: deletion again requires completed or failed; the OpState contract says cancelled does not end an attempt's writes; recorded as rejected ADR-0152; test shows no document deletion after cancelled. The router itself never cancels an upstream operation (only document DELETE), so the waiting deletion is rare and ends as a visible stuck deletion. (2) Verification deadline (B4/B5, TM-08): an unreadable status now ends at verify_timeout_s like a readable pending one, with the last lookup error, and never triggers a resubmission (ADR-0151); a 403 still revokes at once. Fixed before publication: a row without accepted_at (PostgreSQL rows from before migration 4) raised TypeError in unconfirmed(), which would end the outbox TaskGroup and stop all memory delivery; it now counts from created_at (tested). The behaviour change for backend outages longer than the deadline is named in the changelog. (3) aggregate_state (TM-10): computed only from the authorized primary and further-project outcomes already in the answer; no new fact, project or error text; memory_state and the HTTP error policy unchanged; REST and gateway use the same recall_response. (4) Provenance refactor (TM-09): make_provenance keeps the field allowlist, bounds and kind rules byte for byte and still takes origin_client from the authenticated principal; memory_gateway.provenance remains as an alias for existing callers. Docs: ADR-0150 completed to MADR form, ADR-0151 and ADR-0152 added, German design document updated.

tests.evidence: 13 tests: unreadable status stays accepted with the error, then dead with it after the deadline, single send; deletion after failed deletes the document, after cancelled the job stays delete_pending with remote_pending and nothing is deleted (fails with the pull request's previous code); a row without accepted_at is bounded by created_at and does not raise (fails with the previous code).

43 tests, 1 SDK case skipped: aggregate_state available (missing private, answering team), bank_missing (both missing), partial for an unavailable and for a denied further project; provenance validation.

limitations: Hindsight's cancellation semantics come from its documentation (version 1.3) and a partial read of its worker (hindsight_api/worker/poller.py); the cancel handler itself was not read. No live Hindsight was used.
A backend outage longer than verify_timeout_s leaves dead letters for writes the backend may still finish; the operator retries them (documented in the changelog and ADR-0151).
